layout.note: the layout check (ui/specs/layout.mjs): the stage kind and the opening measured on today's goldens (C1); painted, columns, groups, slots and bleed are UI/UX's with the AD

status: Home: a top bar that carries the line, two windows (the Vivarium on the left, the Library on the right) and a console of four stations (Pods, Incubator, Companion and Bay) whose order tells the sequence. The windows and the stations' pictures are placeholders until their own pictures land.
note: The one home of Home's numbers. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] at 1x on 1024 x 600 and every picture is drawn 1:1. The panels, edges, bevels and ticks are the face's own rect primitives, palette-exact. A text at (x, y) is a line box: its cap top is y + (pitch - cap) / 2, the pitch 20 at 16 px and 28 at 20 px.
stateRule: Home has one state. Docked or away changes the Companion and Bay stations' words, never the layout

stage.note: the ground under the bezels and the console; Home has no bottom line, so the stage runs to the foot of the screen (frame.json's stage stops at the line)

bar.note: the shared top bar's picture with Home's own words: the title, the station's place name when the save has one, the date and the clock; no counters and no Companion mark here (they stay on every other screen)

line.note: the line takes over the bottom line's job, centred in its zone and never wrapping; only a subject may end in an ellipsis, and only at the zone's edge

vivarium.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: 620 wide, 12 before the Library

shade.note: build spec 11.5: the window's inner shade replaces the generator's edge gradient, 2 px along the inside top and left edges, drawn as rects; omitted on the placeholder

breath.note: build spec 4.2: four pre-rendered brightness levels of the picture and one whole-picture swap every 2 s, cycling levels 1 2 3 4 3 2 (the main one is level 1); a swap frame is 124,528 px, and the residents do not step on it. Reduced motion: no breathing, level 1 only

glint.note: build spec 4.2: glint-star-12x12 centred on each bead of a look found since the Library was last opened full screen, at most 8 drawn; it fades in and out on the 16-level stage dither over 2 s (in for the first half, out for the second, then again); reduced motion: no fade, the glints simply show

new.note: {n} new, at the lower left, hidden at 0

console.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: 12 under the bezels, 8 over the foot of the screen

pods.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: 226 by 98 at y 477

glint.note: ruled in build spec section 14: the glint star on a pod with one, over the pod's top right corner, 12 x 12 at the slot's (12, 0)

incubator.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: 226 by 98 at y 477

bar.note: ruled in build spec section 14: the bar is lit to progress. It is the lit bar's window of the 56 x 86 layer (the alpha's extent, x 10 to 43, y 71 to 80), 34 px at most, from its first pixel, whole when ready

capsule.note: the painted capsule (masters/capsule/*-56x86): the interior, the bud's pod, the glass (growing), the shell, the door (not growing) and the bar. foot and podHeight are the old Home module's: the pod 27 tall, its foot 27 px in and 63 down

companion.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: 226 by 98 at y 477

plates.note: ruled in build spec section 14: the Probe's plates as line 2, docked, up to 4, 12 x 24, 4 apart (the old module's pitch 16) from (12, 64); a plate is whole or lost

bay.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: 226 by 98 at y 477

picture.note: the crates come first (up to three), then shut berths, the portrait berth last; 82 wide, 102 with the portrait

window.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: the Vivarium bezel's window

painting.source: Idle's painting of the light (frame.json idle.regions.vivarium), cut 1:1
painting.note: columns cx to cx + 603, rows 194 to 555 (the art director: cx = 64); the face cuts it from the same picture the Vivarium uses, so there is no new master

shade.note: section 11.5: the window's inner shade, 2 px along the inside top and left edges, drawn as rects

resident.maxWhy: what fits at 1x: 5 adults with an ink width between, in the 444 px centre span (6 need 550 of 494 px); glassOf caps at shownOf, so vivarium.json rules.show.max and Home agree at 5
resident.order: by the feet's y, lower in front (drawn later), left first on a tie; the met one's (ui.meet) name tag is drawn after every resident, so a walker may pass in front of the met one by depth and is drawn under its tag; walkers do not avoid it

walk.keepOutRule: a figure meets the keep-out when its box reaches x 548 and its feet reach y 344; the keep-out stands only while the away frame shows

nameTag.note: the Vivarium's tag (vivarium.json regions.nameTag), on the mibi that has an event, until the player visits it; no lift

away.offGrid: the build spec's numbers: 64 x 64 at (556, 352)
away.note: the first mibi out on a trip, at its world size, composed from its stand and bottom-centred; the walkers keep out of [548, 344, 80, 96] while it shows

rackPod.note: the pod at the rack class, rendered at 24×32 by the pod renderer, never the 32×40 well pod scaled

layers.pattern: home-rack-pod-pattern-{name}-24x32, name from shellPattern through pods.json podLayers.patterns; a word with no layer draws none
layers.colours: A, B: colourPair[0], [1] .pigment through cross.json colours.pigmentChips; not listed: mist; a pod of no known species: A stone, B fog, no pattern
layers.ramp: light lighter[A]; shade darker[A]; outline the last colour of A's darker chain before ink or void, ink where that would be night
layers.rule: each layer a 1-bit mask; its on pixels take its fill, in order, later over earlier; transparent outside body; palette-exact, 24×32, never scaled

focus.room: no ring is drawn at rest: the confirm key does the first need in the line, and nothing when there is none
focus.held: while events.rest holds, the face moves no focus and sends no intent but room:<x>, which the host drops (events.rest.keys)

keys.confirm: on a bezel opens it full screen; on a station opens its room; at rest does the first need in the line
keys.back: nothing: Home is the top of the tree
keys.home: the ring back to rest; at rest, the Station rests: Idle
keys.library: the Library full screen: its spread, the ring on the frame it was last on
keys.dock: as frame.json navigation.dock: the arrival plays, then Later returns here

rest.keys: a room key during the hold is dropped, never kept: the rest ends on Idle, where the first press only wakes (frame.json idle.keys.rest)

steps.do: the ring is already gone; nothing moves
the screen transition (16-level Bayer dither) to Idle

notes.companionAway: the Companion is on a trip

needs.rule: the notice and the room's ✓, the first that holds: the module it lights, the notice, the action. Counts are spelled (a, two to six); above what the picture holds the count is dropped

crates.noticeOne: a crate waits in the bay
crates.rule: the walk crates in the bay, while docked; the count is theirs, so the Cargo lamp, the notice and the room's ✓ agree (state.need()). A ready portrait is counted apart, docked or away (strings.line.needs.portrait); with walk crates too, the notice names both (strings.line.needs.crates.withPortrait). Cargo's own notice names neither: its bay shows them.

full.rule: every place is taken and something waits for one (a ready bud, or a pod that could be incubated): ahead of the bud and of couldGrow (state.need, the rooms words C9, C11). ✓ jumps to the Vivarium: with a room that can be bought and paid, ✓ Add a room, the ring on the new-room chip (room.new); otherwise ✓ Make room, the ring on the first resident of the room shown

newPods.noticeOne: a new pod in the case

couldGrow.rule: short of what growing it costs, it stays a need: the short notice, then each material that is short as its 16 px icon after the words, Energy ⚡ before Essence ❀ (the top bar's order), one space apart, no figure; both short shows both. If the run passes 256 px (the slot less its lamp and gap), the species goes: "a pod needs more ⚡ ❀"

toRead.rule: short of what reading its next chapter costs, it stays a need: the short notice, ◆ as its 16 px icon after the words, no figure

line.rule: the line at rest: at most two needs joined by a dot, amber, with the amber lamp before them; the first carries the confirm cap and says its action, the second its notice. With none, the goal (frame.json strings.goal), mist. With a target focused: the target's verb with the cap, then its subject, if it has one, in mist.

crates.noticeOne: a crate waits in the Bay

withPortrait.noticeOne: Bay: a crate and a portrait

portrait.notice: a portrait waits in the Bay

newPods.noticeOne: a new pod in the case
